paper.title: Revenue: sample of sales invoices
paper.objective: Test the occurrence and accuracy of recorded revenue by examining a sample of sales invoices.
paper.procedure: Monetary unit sampling over the sales register for FY2025-26; each selected invoice agreed to dispatch note, customer order and subsequent receipt.
paper.population_sample: Population: 1,284 sales invoices totalling 9,800,000.00 (sales register FY2025-26). Formula: interval = population_value / sample_size. Seed: 20261031. Sample size 60. Items selected: INV-0007, INV-0042, INV-0098, INV-0133 (and 56 more listed in the attached selection sheet).
paper.conclusion: Recorded revenue is supported by the sample; no misstatement projected.
